subject: Coordination: Tailored demo + IT/security availability — Orion Health
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@orionhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:15:00-04:00
Subject: Request: Tailored demo + IT/security call — Orion Health

Hi Ben,

Thanks — I signed up through the self-serve flow and would like to schedule a tailored walkthrough for Orion Health. We're interested in latency characteristics for clinical note summarization and the VPC/private deployment options.

Important: Our IT and security team must attend (they'll validate network/egress and audit logging). Can you include an SE and a member of security/operations on the call?

Preferred window (ET): Oct 6–8 between 10:00–15:00 ET. If you need to propose earlier, we can make space on Oct 5 after 16:00 ET.

Attendees on our side: Alex Morgan (PM), Priya Sharma (IT lead), Jordan Li (Security).

Thanks,
Alex Morgan
Product Lead — Orion Health
alex.morgan@orionhealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-01T11:02:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Request: Tailored demo + IT/security call — Orion Health

Hi Alex — great to meet you and thanks for signing up. Happy to coordinate an AE+SE walkthrough that includes IT/security. Looping in Maya (AE) and Soojin (SE) to propose times and capture any checklist items from Priya.

Quick plan:
- Maya will propose 2–3 consolidated slots that fit your ET window.
- Soojin can do a brief pre-demo network check with Priya if needed (15–20m).
- We'll prepare a short agenda and a security artifact bundle ahead of time.

Maya & Soojin — can you propose two options (one earlier in the week, one later) that also work for a 30–45m IT/security block?

Alex — if you have a preferred meeting link or calendar tool, send it over; otherwise we can send a Redwood meeting link.

Best,
Ben Carter
SDR, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@orionhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@orionhealth.com>, Jordan Li <jordan.li@orionhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T08:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Tailored demo + IT/security call — Orion Health

Hi all — thanks for coordinating. A few constraints from IT/security on our side:

- Preferred windows (PT): Oct 6 between 07:00–11:00 PT or Oct 7 between 12:00–15:00 PT (we're West Coast; ET times above map accordingly).
- We need a 20–30m pre-demo network review to confirm firewall rules and egress destinations.
- Please share a security checklist and any SOC/attestation docs in advance.

I've attached our internal checklist for reference (security_requirements.pdf) and a simple network port list template (network_ports.csv) — fill in any Redwood endpoints and we'll validate.

Priya Sharma
IT Lead — Orion Health
priya.sharma@orionhealth.com

From: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@orionhealth.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@orionhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-03T10:35:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Request: Tailored demo + IT/security call — Orion Health

Thanks Priya — and thanks Alex. Proposed approach and slots below (times converted to ET/PT for clarity):

Option A (preferred):
- Demo (AE+SE): Oct 6, 11:00–11:45 ET / 08:00–08:45 PT
- Pre-demo network/security check (SE + Priya): Oct 6, 10:30–10:50 ET / 07:30–07:50 PT

Option B (alternate):
- Demo (AE+SE): Oct 7, 14:00–14:45 ET / 11:00–11:45 PT
- Pre-demo network/security check (SE + Priya): Oct 7, 13:30–13:50 ET / 10:30–10:50 PT

Agenda (30–45m demo):
- 5m intros & objectives
- 10m high-level architecture & deployment modes (hosted / dedicated / private)
- 10m live walkthrough: clinical note summarization pipeline & latency profile
- 10–20m Q&A focused on security/ops and integration flows

Links: we'll send a Redwood meeting link and calendar invite once Alex confirms a slot. I've attached a short agenda (demo_agenda.pdf) and will populate the network_ports.csv with Redwood endpoints for Priya to validate.

If neither slot works, tell us the exact ET/PT window and we'll re-propose.

Thanks,
Maya Srinivasan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai

From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@orionhealth.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@orionhealth.com>, Jordan Li <jordan.li@orionhealth.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@orionhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T08:12:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Request: Tailored demo + IT/security call — Orion Health

Maya — both of those look promising, thank you. Quick notes:

- We prefer Option B (Oct 7, 14:00 ET) but Priya has a conflicting calendar at 13:30 ET on Oct 7. Can we shift the pre-demo check to 14:00–14:20 ET and do the demo 14:30–15:15 ET instead? That gives them a short buffer.
- Our CISO, Evelyn Hart, would like to join the demo for the security/attestation discussion; I copied her on this thread. She is on Central Time (CT) and prefers afternoons CT.
- If Priya can't make the pre-demo, can Soojin run the network checklist asynchronously and we can validate via the network_ports.csv?

If you can confirm, we'll lock the time and I'll add our internal calendar invite. If anyone on Redwood needs an earlier slot for EMEA participants, note we also have an EU clinical lead who might join on Oct 7 at 19:00 CET (late for you but possible if recording/rep).

Thanks,
Alex

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@orionhealth.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya.srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T18:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Tailored demo + IT/security call — Orion Health

Alex / team — confirmed. Final plan below: 

- Pre-demo network check (asynchronous): Soojin will fill Redwood endpoints into network_ports.csv by Oct 6 12:00 PT; Priya can validate and reply with OK or questions.
- Live demo: Oct 7, 14:30–15:15 ET / 11:30–12:15 PT (we'll send a calendar invite with Redwood meeting link).
- Evelyn — welcome to join; we'll make sure to reserve 10–15 minutes for attestation and SOC/KMS discussion.
- Recording: we'll record the session and share the link for your EU colleague who may attend later.

Attachments: calendar_invite.ics (invite stub) and demo_agenda.pdf included.

Links: https://meet.redwood.ai/j/ben-orion-20261005

See you all then.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
